blocks.en: "Lembaga Tabung Haji faced a severe financial and governance crisis between 2014 and 2018, characterized by asset-liability deficits, inflated profit distributions (hibah), and high-risk investments." Discuss the root causes of Tabung Haji's asset impairment and liquidity issues.
blocks.ms: "Lembaga Tabung Haji menghadapi krisis kewangan dan tadbir urus yang teruk antara 2014 dan 2018, dicirikan oleh defisit aset-liabiliti, pengagihan keuntungan (hibah) yang dibesarkan, dan pelaburan berisiko tinggi." Bincangkan punca utama rosot nilai aset dan isu kecairan Tabung Haji.

blocks.en: What the question asks
blocks.ms: Apa yang soalan minta

en: **Root causes**, not a timeline: explain WHY it happened.
Two linked problems: **asset impairment** (assets worth less than recorded) and **liquidity** (not enough liquid assets to pay depositors and distributions).
Use the case's three clues: **asset-liability deficit**, **inflated hibah**, **high-risk investments**, plus **governance**.
ms: **Punca utama**, bukan garis masa: terangkan KENAPA ia berlaku.
Dua masalah berkait: **rosot nilai aset** (aset bernilai kurang daripada rekod) dan **kecairan** (aset cair tidak cukup untuk bayar pendeposit dan pengagihan).
Guna tiga petunjuk kes: **defisit aset-liabiliti**, **hibah dibesarkan**, **pelaburan berisiko tinggi**, serta **tadbir urus**.

Hibah

Total

blocks.en: What the RCI reportedly found

en: Distributions in **2014–2017 exceeded the fund's financial capacity** and depleted its reserves.
Distributions in **2014 and 2015 exceeded actual profits**; in **2016 and 2017 liabilities exceeded assets** yet distributions were made.
**2017:** reported profit **RM3.4 billion**; under full application of the reporting standards the result should have been a **loss of RM1.4 billion**.

TH relied on a **Realisable Asset Value (RAV)** approach, not the asset values in its audited accounts, to judge compliance with **Section 22 of the Tabung Haji Act 1995**; no impairment was made for investments that had fallen below cost.

The Auditor-General flagged that TH **changed its impairment policy twice in 2017**, and had **not recognised RM227.81 million** of impairment on **three subsidiaries and three associates**, including **RM164.58 million on TH Heavy Engineering**.
Financial statements for **2014–2017 received unqualified audit opinions**; the 2017 report contained a **Matter of Emphasis**.
Of a **RM4.6 billion** property valuation used in RAV, only **RM0.56 billion** came from professional valuers; **RM4.04 billion** was management's own estimate.
**14 troubled investments** were recommended for forensic audit (examples reported: Alam Maritim/TH Marine impairment RM278 million; TH Plantations impairment RM170 million).
Governance: the Act lets the **Minister appoint the chairman and board** with no criteria beyond being a Muslim and Malaysian citizen; the RCI found **political interference**.

blocks.en: The 2018 rescue

en: In **December 2018** a Ministry of Finance SPV, **Urusharta Jamaah Sdn Bhd (UJSB)**, took over TH's **underperforming assets with a transfer value of RM19.9 billion** (market value reported at about **RM9.7 billion**).
TH said the asset-liability gap exceeded **RM10 billion** at end-2018 and it would otherwise breach the Act and be unable to declare a 2018 hibah.

Reported financing structure **differs by source**: RM10 billion sukuk + RM9.9 billion redeemable convertible preference shares (Dec 2018 announcement) vs RM19.6 billion sukuk + RM300 million cash (April 2019).
The government committed to annual payments of about **RM1.73 billion** until the sukuk are redeemed; in **September 2023** it announced the assets would be returned to the pilgrim fund.

blocks.en: Where sources disagree

en: **Deficit start:** one report says TH had an asset-liability deficit **since 2014**; another table (RCI basis, before dividends) shows a **surplus in 2014–2015** (RM2.9bn, RM0.1bn) and **deficits in 2016–2017** (RM1.3bn, RM0.8bn).
**2017 position:** PwC-based figures reported: assets **RM70.3bn** vs liabilities **RM74.4bn**; TH's RAV basis: assets **RM74.7bn** vs liabilities RM74.4bn (a **RM373 million surplus**).

**Total loss estimate:** about **RM2.8 billion** on investments TH retained plus **RM10.2 billion** on assets moved to UJSB (total exposure about RM13 billion); another figure cited is RM2.6 billion of impairments on legacy investments 2018–2025.

**1. Weak governance and political influence.** Board appointments were controlled by the Minister with minimal criteria; the RCI reported political interference; individuals held positions across many subsidiaries (concentrated control, weak checks).
**2. High-risk, poorly supervised investments.** Large exposures in subsidiaries and associates (plantations, marine, heavy engineering) that later lost value; 14 investments needed forensic audits.

**3. Accounting that delayed recognition of impairment.** RAV valued assets above audited carrying amounts; no impairment was made when investments fell below cost; the impairment policy was changed twice in 2017; RM227.81 million was not recognised.
**4. Optimistic valuations.** Management's own estimates formed most of the RM4.6 billion property uplift (RM4.04 billion vs RM0.56 billion professionally valued).
**5. Weak oversight.** Unqualified audit opinions for 2014–2017 despite the issues; the investment decisions and valuation methods were not challenged effectively.

blocks.en: Link the causes: weak governance → risky investments → value falls → impairment avoided by accounting choices (RAV, policy changes) → reported profit and net assets overstated → hibah paid on profits that did not exist.
blocks.ms: Hubungkan punca: tadbir urus lemah → pelaburan berisiko → nilai jatuh → rosot nilai dielak melalui pilihan perakaunan (RAV, perubahan dasar) → untung dan aset bersih terlebih nyata → hibah dibayar atas untung yang tidak wujud.

en: **1. Payouts above capacity.** Hibah was paid beyond the fund's capacity (2014–2017), so cash left the fund while profits (and later net assets) did not support it; reserves were depleted.
**2. Asset-liability deficit.** When liabilities (depositors' savings plus hibah) exceed assets, the fund cannot meet all claims even if it sold everything at book value.

**3. Illiquid, impaired assets (analysis).** Property, plantations and stakes in subsidiaries are hard to sell quickly; impaired investments produce little cash, while depositors' savings are repayable on demand (for Hajj or withdrawal): a maturity mismatch.

**4. Dependence on continued trust and inflows (analysis).** Paying high hibah attracts deposits; if payouts exceed earnings, the fund relies on new deposits and reserves to keep paying, which is fragile when confidence falls.

**5. Outcome in 2018.** TH said the gap exceeded RM10 billion; underperforming assets (transfer value RM19.9 billion, market value about RM9.7 billion) were moved to UJSB for sukuk (not cash), and the 2018 hibah fell to 1.25%.

blocks.en: Points 3 and 4 are analysis, not findings quoted from the sources: say "this suggests" in your answer.
blocks.ms: Poin 3 dan 4 ialah analisis, bukan dapatan yang dipetik daripada sumber: guna ayat "ini menunjukkan" dalam jawapan anda.

blocks.en: This section applies the standards you are studying. It is general knowledge of MFRS, not a finding about TH's actual accounting.
blocks.ms: Seksyen ini mengaplikasikan standard yang anda belajar. Ia pengetahuan am MFRS, bukan dapatan tentang perakaunan sebenar TH.

en: **MFRS 136 Impairment of Assets:** an asset is impaired when its **carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount** (higher of fair value less costs of disposal and value in use). The loss goes to **profit or loss** immediately (cost model). Entities must assess at each reporting date whether there are **indications of impairment** (e.g. a significant fall in market value, underperformance).

**Why RAV conflicts with MFRS:** RAV used estimated realisable values rather than carrying amounts after impairment testing, so losses were not recognised; MFRS requires write-downs below cost when recoverable amount is lower.
**Changing the impairment policy** to avoid losses undermines **comparability and faithful representation** (Conceptual Framework).

**MFRS 140 Investment Property:** under the fair value model, falls in fair value hit profit or loss each year; under the cost model, impairment is tested. Property uplifts based on management estimates weaken reliability.
**MFRS 141 / 116 (plantations):** biological assets are at fair value less costs to sell; bearer plants are PPE at cost less depreciation and impairment.
**MFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement:** valuations should use observable inputs; professional valuers and disclosure of assumptions improve reliability.
**Disclosure and audit:** unqualified opinions despite concerns raise questions on audit scepticism and the adequacy of disclosure.
ms: **MFRS 136 Rosot Nilai Aset:** aset rosot nilai bila **amaun dibawa melebihi amaun boleh pulih** (yang lebih tinggi antara nilai saksama tolak kos pelupusan dan nilai guna). Kerugian terus ke **untung atau rugi** (model kos). Entiti mesti menilai setiap tarikh pelaporan sama ada ada **petunjuk rosot nilai** (cth kejatuhan ketara nilai pasaran, prestasi lemah).

**Kenapa RAV bercanggah dengan MFRS:** RAV guna nilai boleh realisasi anggaran, bukan amaun dibawa selepas ujian rosot nilai, jadi kerugian tidak diiktiraf; MFRS memerlukan tulis turun di bawah kos bila amaun boleh pulih lebih rendah.
**Menukar dasar rosot nilai** untuk elak kerugian menjejaskan **kebolehbandingan dan perwakilan saksama** (Kerangka Konseptual).

**MFRS 140 Hartanah Pelaburan:** di bawah model nilai saksama, kejatuhan nilai saksama menjejaskan untung atau rugi setiap tahun; di bawah model kos, rosot nilai diuji. Kenaikan nilai hartanah berdasarkan anggaran pengurusan melemahkan kebolehpercayaan.
**MFRS 141 / 116 (ladang):** aset biologi pada nilai saksama tolak kos menjual; bearer plants ialah PPE pada kos tolak susut nilai dan rosot nilai.
**MFRS 13 Pengukuran Nilai Saksama:** penilaian patut guna input boleh diperhatikan; penilai profesional dan pendedahan andaian menambah kebolehpercayaan.
**Pendedahan dan audit:** pendapat tanpa kelayakan walaupun ada kebimbangan menimbulkan persoalan tentang skeptisisme audit dan kecukupan pendedahan.

en: **Reported RCI recommendations:** bar active politicians from the boards of TH and its subsidiaries; provide expressly for the Investment Panel, Syariah Advisory Committee and Haj Management Committee under the Act; forensic audits on 14 troubled investments (the reports mention police reports and MACC referrals).
**Competence and independence:** board appointment criteria beyond religion and nationality (e.g. finance, investment and risk expertise).
**Accounting discipline:** apply MFRS impairment and fair value rules fully; do not rely on non-MFRS measures to justify distributions.
**Distribution policy:** pay hibah only from **real, sustainable profit** and keep adequate reserves; align payouts with realised earnings.
**Liquidity management:** match asset maturity to depositors' withdrawal profile; hold liquid assets for Hajj demand.
**Audit and disclosure:** stronger audit scepticism, clear disclosure of valuation methods and impairment policy changes.

blocks.en: Audit report: Root causes of asset impairment and liquidity issues at Lembaga Tabung Haji (2014 to 2018)
blocks.ms: Laporan audit: Punca rosot nilai aset dan isu kecairan Lembaga Tabung Haji (2014 hingga 2018)

blocks.en: 1. Objective and scope
blocks.ms: 1. Objektif dan skop

blocks.en: Objective: to identify the root causes of the asset impairment and liquidity problems at Lembaga Tabung Haji (TH). Scope: 2014 to 2018, based on public reporting of the Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) and the Auditor-General's observations. Limitation: I could not open the full RCI report; figures are as reported and sources differ in places.
blocks.ms: Objektif: mengenal pasti punca masalah rosot nilai aset dan kecairan Lembaga Tabung Haji (TH). Skop: 2014 hingga 2018, berdasarkan laporan awam Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) dan pemerhatian Ketua Audit Negara. Had: laporan penuh RCI tidak dapat dibuka; angka seperti dilaporkan dan sumber berbeza di beberapa tempat.

blocks.en: 2. Executive summary
blocks.ms: 2. Ringkasan eksekutif

blocks.en: TH paid high hibah while its audited position weakened. Weak governance allowed high-risk investments; accounting choices (RAV, policy changes, management valuations) delayed impairment and overstated profit; and payouts, illiquid assets and a deficit created a liquidity problem that ended in a RM19.9 billion transfer of underperforming assets to a Ministry of Finance SPV in December 2018. Seven findings follow.
blocks.ms: TH membayar hibah tinggi sedangkan kedudukan teraudit melemah. Tadbir urus lemah membenarkan pelaburan berisiko tinggi; pilihan perakaunan (RAV, perubahan dasar, penilaian pengurusan) melewatkan rosot nilai dan melebihkan untung; dan bayaran, aset tidak cair serta defisit mewujudkan masalah kecairan yang berakhir dengan pemindahan aset kurang prestasi RM19.9 bilion kepada SPV Kementerian Kewangan pada Disember 2018. Tujuh penemuan menyusul.

blocks.en: 3. Findings
blocks.ms: 3. Penemuan

blocks.en: Finding 1: Impairment of investments was not recognised
blocks.ms: Penemuan 1: Rosot nilai pelaburan tidak diiktiraf

en: Element
Detail
Criteria (standard / requirement)

MFRS 136 para 9: assess at each reporting date whether there is any indication of impairment. Para 59–60: if the recoverable amount is below the carrying amount, reduce it and recognise the impairment loss immediately in profit or loss. MFRS 136 covers investments in subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures (para 4); MFRS 128 para 40–43 for associates.
ms: MFRS 136 para 9: nilai pada setiap tarikh pelaporan sama ada ada petunjuk rosot nilai. Para 59–60: jika amaun boleh pulih di bawah amaun dibawa, kurangkan dan iktiraf kerugian rosot nilai serta-merta dalam untung atau rugi. MFRS 136 meliputi pelaburan dalam subsidiari, syarikat bersekutu dan usaha sama (para 4); MFRS 128 para 40–43 untuk syarikat bersekutu.

en: Condition (what was found)

The Auditor-General reported RM227.81 million of impairment not recognised in 2017 on three subsidiaries and three associates, including RM164.58 million on TH Heavy Engineering. The RCI reported that no impairment was made for investments that had fallen below cost. Later impairments reported include RM278 million (Alam Maritim/TH Marine) and RM170 million (TH Plantations).
ms: Ketua Audit Negara melaporkan rosot nilai RM227.81 juta tidak diiktiraf pada 2017 atas tiga subsidiari dan tiga syarikat bersekutu, termasuk RM164.58 juta atas TH Heavy Engineering. RCI melaporkan tiada rosot nilai dibuat untuk pelaburan yang jatuh di bawah kos. Rosot nilai kemudian yang dilaporkan termasuk RM278 juta (Alam Maritim/TH Marine) dan RM170 juta (TH Plantations).

en: Cause (why it happened)

TH relied on the Realisable Asset Value (RAV) approach instead of carrying amounts after impairment testing; weak oversight of investments; "creative accounting" as described by the RCI (as reported).
ms: TH bergantung pada pendekatan Nilai Aset Boleh Realisasi (RAV) dan bukannya amaun dibawa selepas ujian rosot nilai; pengawasan pelaburan lemah; "perakaunan kreatif" seperti diterangkan RCI (seperti dilaporkan).

en: Effect (the impact)

Profit and net assets were overstated. The 2017 reported profit of RM3.4 billion should have been a RM1.4 billion loss under full application of the standards (a swing of RM4.8 billion). Hibah was paid on profit that had not been earned.
ms: Untung dan aset bersih terlebih nyata. Untung dilaporkan 2017 RM3.4 bilion sepatutnya rugi RM1.4 bilion di bawah pemakaian penuh piawaian (perbezaan RM4.8 bilion). Hibah dibayar atas untung yang belum diperoleh.

en: Recommendation
Test every investment for impairment at each reporting date using MFRS 136, document the indicators and the recoverable amount, and have the audit committee review them.
ms: Uji setiap pelaburan untuk rosot nilai pada setiap tarikh pelaporan menggunakan MFRS 136, dokumenkan petunjuk dan amaun boleh pulih, dan minta jawatankuasa audit menyemaknya.

blocks.en: Finding 2: Accounting policy on impairment was changed
blocks.ms: Penemuan 2: Dasar perakaunan rosot nilai ditukar

en: Element
Detail
Criteria (standard / requirement)
MFRS 108 para 14: change an accounting policy only if required by an MFRS or if it gives reliable and more relevant information. Conceptual Framework: faithful representation and comparability.
ms: MFRS 108 para 14: tukar dasar perakaunan hanya jika dikehendaki MFRS atau memberi maklumat boleh dipercayai dan lebih relevan. Kerangka Konseptual: perwakilan saksama dan kebolehbandingan.

en: Condition (what was found)
The Auditor-General flagged that TH changed its impairment policy twice in 2017.
ms: Ketua Audit Negara menanda TH menukar dasar rosot nilai dua kali pada 2017.

en: Cause (why it happened)
Described by the RCI as "creative accounting" that propped up high hibah payouts. The reports I found do not state management's intention: any link to avoiding losses is an inference.
ms: Diterangkan RCI sebagai "perakaunan kreatif" yang menyokong bayaran hibah tinggi. Laporan yang saya jumpa tidak menyatakan niat pengurusan: sebarang kaitan dengan mengelak kerugian ialah inferens.

en: Effect (the impact)
Comparability across years was lost and losses were deferred, so users could not see the true performance of the fund.
ms: Kebolehbandingan antara tahun hilang dan kerugian ditangguhkan, jadi pengguna tak dapat melihat prestasi sebenar dana.

en: Recommendation
Allow policy changes only when justified under MFRS 108, disclosed, and approved by the audit committee.
ms: Benarkan perubahan dasar hanya bila wajar di bawah MFRS 108, didedahkan, dan diluluskan jawatankuasa audit.

blocks.en: Finding 3: Valuations were not reliable (RAV)
blocks.ms: Penemuan 3: Penilaian tidak boleh dipercayai (RAV)

en: Element
Detail
Criteria (standard / requirement)

MFRS 13 para 61 and 67: use valuation techniques appropriate to the circumstances and maximise observable inputs. MFRS 116 para 32: fair value of land and buildings is usually determined from market evidence by professionally qualified valuers.
ms: MFRS 13 para 61 dan 67: guna teknik penilaian yang sesuai dan maksimumkan input boleh diperhatikan. MFRS 116 para 32: nilai saksama tanah dan bangunan biasanya ditentukan daripada bukti pasaran oleh penilai profesional berkelayakan.

en: Condition (what was found)

Of a RM4.6 billion property valuation used in RAV, only RM0.56 billion came from professional valuers; RM4.04 billion was management's own estimate. On RAV, 2017 assets were RM74.7 billion against liabilities of RM74.4 billion (a RM373 million surplus); on the PwC-based figures reported, assets were RM70.3 billion (a difference of about RM4.4 billion between the two bases).
ms: Daripada penilaian hartanah RM4.6 bilion yang digunakan dalam RAV, hanya RM0.56 bilion daripada penilai profesional; RM4.04 bilion anggaran pengurusan sendiri. Atas RAV, aset 2017 RM74.7 bilion berbanding liabiliti RM74.4 bilion (lebihan RM373 juta); atas angka berasaskan PwC yang dilaporkan, aset RM70.3 bilion (beza kira-kira RM4.4 bilion antara dua asas).

en: Cause (why it happened)
RAV is not an MFRS measure and depended on internal estimates; independent valuation was not applied to most of the uplift (this last point is my inference from the figures).
ms: RAV bukan ukuran MFRS dan bergantung pada anggaran dalaman; penilaian bebas tidak dipakai pada kebanyakan kenaikan (poin terakhir ini inferens saya daripada angka).

en: Effect (the impact)
Assets looked sufficient on paper, so the test for paying hibah appeared to be met while the audited position was a deficit.
ms: Aset nampak mencukupi atas kertas, jadi ujian untuk membayar hibah nampak dipenuhi sedangkan kedudukan teraudit ialah defisit.

en: Recommendation
Require independent professional valuations, disclose methods and assumptions, and reconcile any non-MFRS measure to the audited accounts.
ms: Wajibkan penilaian profesional bebas, dedah kaedah dan andaian, dan selaraskan sebarang ukuran bukan MFRS kepada akaun teraudit.

blocks.en: Finding 4: Hibah was paid beyond the fund's capacity
blocks.ms: Penemuan 4: Hibah dibayar melebihi keupayaan dana

en: Element
Detail
Criteria (standard / requirement)
Section 22, Tabung Haji Act 1995 (described in reports as the compliance test for distribution: read the exact wording). MFRS 101 para 15: fair presentation of financial position and performance.
ms: Seksyen 22, Akta Tabung Haji 1995 (diterangkan dalam laporan sebagai ujian pematuhan untuk agihan: baca perkataan tepat). MFRS 101 para 15: pembentangan saksama kedudukan dan prestasi kewangan.

en: Condition (what was found)

Total distributions: 2014 8.25%; 2015 8.00%; 2016 5.75%; 2017 6.25%. The RCI reported that 2014 and 2015 distributions exceeded actual profits, and that in 2016 and 2017 liabilities exceeded assets yet hibah was paid.
ms: Jumlah agihan: 2014 8.25%; 2015 8.00%; 2016 5.75%; 2017 6.25%. RCI melaporkan agihan 2014 dan 2015 melebihi untung sebenar, dan pada 2016 dan 2017 liabiliti melebihi aset tetapi hibah tetap dibayar.

en: Cause (why it happened)

RAV was used to show compliance with s.22; weak governance and political interference (RCI). Pressure to keep competitive returns is a possible reason but is not stated in the reports I found (inference).
ms: RAV digunakan untuk menunjukkan pematuhan s.22; tadbir urus lemah dan campur tangan politik (RCI). Tekanan mengekalkan pulangan kompetitif ialah sebab mungkin tetapi tidak dinyatakan dalam laporan yang saya jumpa (inferens).

en: Effect (the impact)
Reserves were depleted, cash left the fund without matching earnings, the asset-liability deficit deepened, and hibah for 2018 fell to 1.25%, the lowest in TH's history.
ms: Rizab susut, tunai keluar tanpa pendapatan sepadan, defisit aset-liabiliti mendalam, dan hibah 2018 jatuh kepada 1.25%, terendah dalam sejarah TH.

en: Recommendation
Distribute hibah only from real, sustainable profit, supported by an MFRS-based solvency test approved by the board.
ms: Agih hibah hanya daripada untung sebenar yang mampan, disokong ujian kesolvenan berasaskan MFRS yang diluluskan lembaga.

blocks.en: Finding 5: Asset-liability deficit and liquidity pressure
blocks.ms: Penemuan 5: Defisit aset-liabiliti dan tekanan kecairan

en: Element
Detail
Criteria (standard / requirement)
MFRS 101 para 25–26: assess the entity's ability to continue as a going concern. MFRS 7 para 39 (and 33–35): disclose a maturity analysis and manage liquidity risk.
ms: MFRS 101 para 25–26: nilai keupayaan entiti meneruskan operasi (going concern). MFRS 7 para 39 (dan 33–35): dedah analisis kematangan dan urus risiko kecairan.

en: Condition (what was found)

PwC-based figures reported for 2017: assets RM70.3 billion against liabilities RM74.4 billion (a deficit of about RM4.1 billion). TH said the gap exceeded RM10 billion at end-2018. Sources differ on whether the deficit began in 2014 or 2016.
ms: Angka berasaskan PwC yang dilaporkan untuk 2017: aset RM70.3 bilion berbanding liabiliti RM74.4 bilion (defisit kira-kira RM4.1 bilion). TH kata jurang melebihi RM10 bilion pada akhir 2018. Sumber berbeza sama ada defisit bermula pada 2014 atau 2016.

en: Cause (why it happened)

Payouts above capacity; impaired and illiquid assets (property, plantations, subsidiary stakes) held against savings that can be withdrawn on demand (a maturity mismatch: analysis); reliance on continued deposits and confidence (analysis).
ms: Bayaran melebihi keupayaan; aset rosot nilai dan tidak cair (hartanah, ladang, pegangan subsidiari) dipegang berbanding simpanan yang boleh dikeluarkan bila-bila masa (ketakpadanan tempoh matang: analisis); bergantung pada deposit dan keyakinan berterusan (analisis).

en: Effect (the impact)

In December 2018 a Ministry of Finance SPV (Urusharta Jamaah) took over underperforming assets with a transfer value of RM19.9 billion (market value about RM9.7 billion); the government committed about RM1.73 billion a year until the sukuk are redeemed; public confidence in the fund was damaged.
ms: Pada Disember 2018 SPV Kementerian Kewangan (Urusharta Jamaah) mengambil alih aset kurang prestasi dengan nilai pindah RM19.9 bilion (nilai pasaran kira-kira RM9.7 bilion); kerajaan komited kira-kira RM1.73 bilion setahun sehingga sukuk ditebus; keyakinan awam terhadap dana tercalar.

en: Recommendation
Match asset maturity to withdrawal patterns, hold a liquidity buffer for Hajj demand, run stress tests, and report liquidity risk to the board regularly.
ms: Padankan tempoh matang aset dengan corak pengeluaran, simpan penampan kecairan untuk permintaan Haji, jalankan ujian tekanan, dan laporkan risiko kecairan kepada lembaga secara berkala.

blocks.en: Finding 6: Weak governance and political interference
blocks.ms: Penemuan 6: Tadbir urus lemah dan campur tangan politik

en: Element
Detail
Criteria (standard / requirement)
Tabung Haji Act 1995 (board appointment provisions). Malaysian Code on Corporate Governance: board independence and competence, risk management and internal control.
ms: Akta Tabung Haji 1995 (peruntukan pelantikan lembaga). Kod Tadbir Urus Korporat Malaysia: kebebasan dan kecekapan lembaga, pengurusan risiko dan kawalan dalaman.

en: Condition (what was found)

The Act lets the Minister appoint the chairman and board with no criteria beyond being a Muslim and a Malaysian citizen. The RCI found political interference. One former board member and CEO held positions in seven subsidiaries (and three more after tenure ended in June 2016). The RCI recommended forensic audits of 14 troubled investments.
ms: Akta membenarkan Menteri melantik pengerusi dan lembaga tanpa kriteria selain Muslim dan warganegara Malaysia. RCI mendapati campur tangan politik. Seorang bekas ahli lembaga dan CEO memegang jawatan dalam tujuh subsidiari (dan tiga lagi selepas tempoh tamat Jun 2016). RCI mengesyorkan audit forensik atas 14 pelaburan bermasalah.

en: Cause (why it happened)
Statutory criteria for directors were minimal; power was concentrated in a few individuals; conflicts and oversight were not controlled (inference).
ms: Kriteria statutori untuk pengarah minimum; kuasa tertumpu pada beberapa individu; konflik dan pengawasan tidak dikawal (inferens).

en: Effect (the impact)
High-risk investments were approved without enough challenge, leading to losses and impairments (Findings 1 to 3).
ms: Pelaburan berisiko tinggi diluluskan tanpa cabaran mencukupi, membawa kepada kerugian dan rosot nilai (Penemuan 1 hingga 3).

en: Recommendation

Bar active politicians from boards, set competence criteria, give the Investment Panel, Syariah Advisory Committee and Haj Management Committee a statutory footing, and limit multiple subsidiary directorships.
ms: Halang ahli politik aktif daripada lembaga, tetapkan kriteria kecekapan, beri Panel Pelaburan, Jawatankuasa Penasihat Syariah dan Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Haji asas statutori, dan hadkan jawatan pengarah berbilang subsidiari.

blocks.en: Finding 7: Audit and assurance did not detect or report the issues
blocks.ms: Penemuan 7: Audit dan jaminan tidak mengesan atau melaporkan isu

en: Element
Detail
Criteria (standard / requirement)

ISA 200: plan and perform the audit with professional scepticism. ISA 705 and ISA 706: modified opinions and emphasis-of-matter paragraphs. Management must prepare financial statements in compliance with MFRS.
ms: ISA 200: rancang dan jalankan audit dengan skeptisisme profesional. ISA 705 dan ISA 706: pendapat terubah suai dan perenggan penekanan perkara. Pengurusan mesti menyediakan penyata kewangan mengikut MFRS.

en: Condition (what was found)

Financial statements for 2014 to 2017 received unqualified opinions; the 2017 report contained a Matter of Emphasis. The RCI later concluded that 2017 would have been a loss under full application of the standards.
ms: Penyata kewangan 2014 hingga 2017 mendapat pendapat tanpa kelayakan; laporan 2017 mengandungi Perkara Penekanan. RCI kemudian menyimpulkan 2017 akan menjadi rugi di bawah pemakaian penuh piawaian.

en: Cause (why it happened)
Reliance on management estimates and on RAV outside the statements; limited challenge of policy changes (analysis: the reports I found do not explain the auditors' reasoning).
ms: Bergantung pada anggaran pengurusan dan RAV di luar penyata; cabaran terhad terhadap perubahan dasar (analisis: laporan yang saya jumpa tidak menerangkan alasan juruaudit).

en: Effect (the impact)
Depositors and stakeholders were reassured by clean opinions while the true position was weaker; the problems surfaced late.
ms: Pendeposit dan pihak berkepentingan diyakinkan oleh pendapat bersih sedangkan kedudukan sebenar lebih lemah; masalah muncul lewat.

en: Recommendation
Strengthen the audit committee, require auditors to challenge policy changes and non-MFRS measures, and disclose any reconciliation between RAV and audited accounts.
ms: Perkukuh jawatankuasa audit, minta juruaudit mencabar perubahan dasar dan ukuran bukan MFRS, dan dedah sebarang penyesuaian antara RAV dan akaun teraudit.

blocks.en: 5. Overall conclusion
blocks.ms: 5. Kesimpulan keseluruhan

blocks.en: The impairment problem and the liquidity problem reinforce each other. Impaired assets produce little cash and cannot be sold quickly, while distributions above earnings drain cash; accounting choices hid both until a rescue was needed. The root cause is governance: weak board criteria, political influence and weak oversight allowed risky investments and non-MFRS measures to go unchallenged.
blocks.ms: Masalah rosot nilai dan masalah kecairan saling menguatkan. Aset rosot nilai menjana sedikit tunai dan tak boleh dijual cepat, sementara agihan melebihi pendapatan menyusutkan tunai; pilihan perakaunan menyembunyikan kedua-duanya sehingga penyelamatan diperlukan. Punca utamanya ialah tadbir urus: kriteria lembaga lemah, pengaruh politik dan pengawasan lemah membenarkan pelaburan berisiko dan ukuran bukan MFRS tidak dicabar.

blocks.en: 6. Overall recommendations
blocks.ms: 6. Cadangan keseluruhan

en: Apply MFRS 136, MFRS 108 and MFRS 13 fully and consistently.
Pay hibah only from real, sustainable profit with an MFRS-based solvency test.
Match asset maturity to withdrawal demand and hold a liquidity buffer.
Reform board appointment: competence criteria, no active politicians, statutory committees.
Strengthen audit scepticism and disclosure of any non-MFRS measure.
ms: Guna MFRS 136, MFRS 108 dan MFRS 13 sepenuhnya dan konsisten.
Bayar hibah hanya daripada untung sebenar yang mampan dengan ujian kesolvenan berasaskan MFRS.
Padankan tempoh matang aset dengan permintaan pengeluaran dan simpan penampan kecairan.
Reformasi pelantikan lembaga: kriteria kecekapan, tiada ahli politik aktif, jawatankuasa statutori.
Perkukuh skeptisisme audit dan pendedahan sebarang ukuran bukan MFRS.

q.en: What is the assignment about?

a.en: Root causes of Tabung Haji's asset impairment and liquidity issues (2014–2018); max 6 pages, single spacing, font 13.
a.ms: Punca rosot nilai aset dan isu kecairan Tabung Haji (2014–2018); maksimum 6 muka surat, jarak tunggal, fon 13.

q.en: Hibah totals 2014–2017 (hibah + bonus)
Hibah in 2018

a.en: 1.25%: the lowest in TH's history.
a.ms: 1.25%: terendah dalam sejarah TH.

q.en: 2017 reported vs RCI view

a.en: Reported profit RM3.4 billion; under full MFRS a RM1.4 billion loss.
a.ms: Untung dilaporkan RM3.4 bilion; di bawah MFRS penuh rugi RM1.4 bilion.

q.en: What is RAV?

a.en: Realisable Asset Value: TH's approach to judge compliance with s.22 of the TH Act, instead of audited carrying amounts.
a.ms: Realisable Asset Value: pendekatan TH menilai pematuhan s.22 Akta TH, bukannya amaun dibawa teraudit.

q.en: Impairment policy in 2017

a.en: Changed twice (per the Auditor-General).
a.ms: Ditukar dua kali (menurut Ketua Audit Negara).

q.en: Unrecognised impairment flagged by the Auditor-General
q.ms: Rosot nilai tidak diiktiraf yang ditanda Ketua Audit Negara

a.en: RM227.81 million on three subsidiaries and three associates (incl. RM164.58 million on TH Heavy Engineering).
a.ms: RM227.81 juta atas tiga subsidiari dan tiga syarikat bersekutu (termasuk RM164.58 juta TH Heavy Engineering).

q.en: Audit opinions 2014–2017

a.en: Unqualified; the 2017 report had a Matter of Emphasis.
a.ms: Tanpa kelayakan; laporan 2017 ada Perkara Penekanan.

q.en: Property valuation in RAV

a.en: Of RM4.6 billion, only RM0.56 billion from professional valuers; RM4.04 billion management estimate.
a.ms: Daripada RM4.6 bilion, hanya RM0.56 bilion daripada penilai profesional; RM4.04 bilion anggaran pengurusan.

q.en: 2018 rescue

a.en: MoF SPV Urusharta Jamaah took over underperforming assets (transfer value RM19.9 billion; market value about RM9.7 billion).
a.ms: SPV Kementerian Kewangan Urusharta Jamaah mengambil alih aset kurang prestasi (nilai pindah RM19.9 bilion; nilai pasaran kira-kira RM9.7 bilion).

q.en: Why did TH need the 2018 rescue?

a.en: Asset-liability gap over RM10 billion; otherwise it would breach the Act and be unable to pay hibah.
a.ms: Jurang aset-liabiliti melebihi RM10 bilion; jika tidak ia melanggar Akta dan tak boleh bayar hibah.

q.en: Root causes of impairment (5)

a.en: Weak governance/politics; risky investments; accounting delaying impairment; optimistic valuations; weak oversight/audit.
a.ms: Tadbir urus lemah/politik; pelaburan berisiko; perakaunan melewatkan rosot nilai; penilaian optimistik; pengawasan/audit lemah.

q.en: Governance weakness in the TH Act
q.ms: Kelemahan tadbir urus dalam Akta TH

a.en: Minister appoints chairman and board with criteria only of Muslim and Malaysian citizen.
a.ms: Menteri lantik pengerusi dan lembaga dengan kriteria hanya Muslim dan warganegara Malaysia.

q.en: Link: governance → impairment

a.en: Weak governance → risky investments → value falls → impairment avoided by accounting choices → profit overstated.
a.ms: Tadbir urus lemah → pelaburan berisiko → nilai jatuh → rosot nilai dielak melalui pilihan perakaunan → untung terlebih nyata.

q.en: Root causes of liquidity problems (5)

a.en: Payouts above capacity; asset-liability deficit; illiquid impaired assets; dependence on inflows/confidence; 2018 outcome (rescue, low hibah).
a.ms: Bayaran melebihi keupayaan; defisit aset-liabiliti; aset tidak cair dan rosot; bergantung pada aliran masuk/keyakinan; hasil 2018 (penyelamatan, hibah rendah).

q.en: What is a maturity mismatch?

a.en: Liabilities repayable on demand funded by assets that are slow to sell.
a.ms: Liabiliti boleh dituntut bila-bila masa dibiayai oleh aset yang lambat dijual.

q.en: Why does paying hibah above profit hurt liquidity?
q.ms: Kenapa bayar hibah melebihi untung menjejas kecairan?

a.en: Cash leaves the fund without matching earnings, so reserves are depleted.
a.ms: Tunai keluar tanpa pendapatan sepadan, jadi rizab susut.

q.en: When is an asset impaired (MFRS 136)?

a.en: Carrying amount > recoverable amount (higher of FVLCD and value in use).
a.ms: Amaun dibawa > amaun boleh pulih (lebih tinggi antara FVLCD dan nilai guna).

q.en: Why conflicts RAV with MFRS?

a.en: RAV used estimated realisable values rather than carrying amounts after impairment testing.
a.ms: RAV guna nilai boleh realisasi anggaran, bukan amaun dibawa selepas ujian rosot nilai.

q.en: Conceptual Framework issues in the case

a.en: Faithful representation and comparability were undermined by policy changes and non-MFRS measures.
a.ms: Perwakilan saksama dan kebolehbandingan terjejas oleh perubahan dasar dan ukuran bukan MFRS.

q.en: Reported RCI recommendations

a.en: Bar active politicians from boards; give the Investment Panel and Syariah/Haj committees statutory footing; forensic audits on 14 investments.
a.ms: Halang ahli politik aktif dalam lembaga; beri Panel Pelaburan dan jawatankuasa Syariah/Haji asas statutori; audit forensik 14 pelaburan.

q.en: Distribution policy lesson

a.en: Pay hibah only from real, sustainable profit and keep adequate reserves.
a.ms: Bayar hibah hanya daripada untung sebenar yang mampan dan kekalkan rizab mencukupi.

q.en: The four elements of an audit finding

a.en: Criteria (what should be), Condition (what is), Cause (why), Effect (so what).
a.ms: Kriteria (apa yang sepatutnya), Keadaan (apa yang berlaku), Punca (kenapa), Kesan (jadi apa).

q.en: Criteria vs Condition

a.en: Criteria = the standard or requirement; condition = the facts found. The gap between them is the finding.
a.ms: Kriteria = standard atau keperluan; keadaan = fakta ditemui. Jurang antara keduanya ialah penemuan.

q.en: Criteria: failure to recognise impairment

a.en: MFRS 136 para 9 (assess indications) and para 59–60 (write down to recoverable amount, loss in P/L).
a.ms: MFRS 136 para 9 (nilai petunjuk) dan para 59–60 (tulis turun kepada amaun boleh pulih, kerugian dalam P/L).

q.en: Criteria: changing the impairment policy

a.en: MFRS 108 para 14: only if required by an MFRS or it gives reliable and more relevant information.
a.ms: MFRS 108 para 14: hanya jika dikehendaki MFRS atau memberi maklumat boleh dipercayai dan lebih relevan.

q.en: Criteria: reliability of valuations

a.en: MFRS 13 para 61 and 67 (maximise observable inputs); MFRS 116 para 32 (professionally qualified valuers).
a.ms: MFRS 13 para 61 dan 67 (maksimumkan input boleh diperhatikan); MFRS 116 para 32 (penilai profesional berkelayakan).

q.en: Criteria: going concern and liquidity

a.en: MFRS 101 para 25–26 (going concern); MFRS 7 para 39 (maturity analysis).
a.ms: MFRS 101 para 25–26 (going concern); MFRS 7 para 39 (analisis kematangan).

q.en: Criteria: auditor behaviour

a.en: ISA 200 professional scepticism; ISA 705/706 for modified opinions and emphasis of matter.
a.ms: ISA 200 skeptisisme profesional; ISA 705/706 untuk pendapat terubah suai dan penekanan perkara.

q.en: "Lembaga Tabung Haji faced a severe financial and governance crisis between 2014 and 2018, characterized by asset-liability deficits, inflated profit distributions (hibah), and high-risk investments." Discuss the root causes of Tabung Haji's asset impairment and liquidity issues. Present your answer in audit-report format (criteria, condition, cause, effect).
q.ms: "Lembaga Tabung Haji menghadapi krisis kewangan dan tadbir urus yang teruk antara 2014 dan 2018, dicirikan oleh defisit aset-liabiliti, pengagihan keuntungan (hibah) yang dibesarkan, dan pelaburan berisiko tinggi." Bincangkan punca utama rosot nilai aset dan isu kecairan Tabung Haji. Bentangkan jawapan anda dalam format laporan audit (kriteria, keadaan, punca, kesan).

en: Objective, scope and brief background (2)
Impairment not recognised: criteria (MFRS 136 para 9, 59–60) and condition (figures) (4)
Cause and effect of non-recognition: RAV, policy changes, governance; profit RM3.4 billion vs RM1.4 billion loss (3)
Valuation reliability: criteria (MFRS 13, MFRS 116 para 32), condition RM4.6 billion vs RM0.56 billion, effect (3)
Hibah beyond capacity: criteria (s.22, MFRS 101), condition (rates), cause and effect (3)
Liquidity and deficit: criteria (MFRS 101 para 25–26, MFRS 7), cause (maturity mismatch), effect (2018 rescue) (3)
Governance and audit oversight, with conclusion and recommendations (2)
ms: Objektif, skop dan latar belakang ringkas (2)
Rosot nilai tidak diiktiraf: kriteria (MFRS 136 para 9, 59–60) dan keadaan (angka) (4)
Punca dan kesan tidak mengiktiraf: RAV, perubahan dasar, tadbir urus; untung RM3.4 bilion vs rugi RM1.4 bilion (3)
Kebolehpercayaan penilaian: kriteria (MFRS 13, MFRS 116 para 32), keadaan RM4.6 bilion vs RM0.56 bilion, kesan (3)
Hibah melebihi keupayaan: kriteria (s.22, MFRS 101), keadaan (kadar), punca dan kesan (3)
Kecairan dan defisit: kriteria (MFRS 101 para 25–26, MFRS 7), punca (ketakpadanan tempoh matang), kesan (penyelamatan 2018) (3)
Tadbir urus dan pengawasan audit, dengan kesimpulan dan cadangan (2)

q.en: Explain how applying MFRS 136 impairment requirements properly could have changed Tabung Haji's reported results and its ability to pay hibah.
q.ms: Terangkan bagaimana pemakaian keperluan rosot nilai MFRS 136 yang betul boleh mengubah keputusan dilaporkan Tabung Haji dan keupayaannya membayar hibah.

en: Indicators of impairment: investments below cost, falling market values (2)
Compare carrying amount with recoverable amount (higher of FVLCD and value in use) (2)
Recognise the impairment loss in profit or loss (1)
Reported profit lower, 2017 closer to the RM1.4 billion loss (1)
Distributable profit and net assets lower, so hibah payouts reduced (2)
ms: Petunjuk rosot nilai: pelaburan di bawah kos, nilai pasaran jatuh (2)
Banding amaun dibawa dengan amaun boleh pulih (lebih tinggi antara FVLCD dan nilai guna) (2)
Iktiraf kerugian rosot nilai dalam untung atau rugi (1)
Untung dilaporkan lebih rendah, 2017 lebih hampir kepada rugi RM1.4 bilion (1)
Untung boleh diagih dan aset bersih lebih rendah, jadi bayaran hibah dikurangkan (2)

q.en: Distinguish between asset impairment and liquidity problems in the Tabung Haji case and explain how each reinforced the other.
q.ms: Bezakan rosot nilai aset dan masalah kecairan dalam kes Tabung Haji dan terangkan bagaimana setiap satu menguatkan yang lain.

en: Impairment: assets worth less than carrying amounts (a value problem) (2)
Liquidity: not enough cash/liquid assets to meet obligations (a cash problem) (2)
Impaired assets generate little cash and are hard to sell, worsening liquidity (2)
Payouts above profit drain cash and expose the fund to withdrawal risk, adding pressure to hide losses (2)
ms: Rosot nilai: aset bernilai kurang daripada amaun dibawa (masalah nilai) (2)
Kecairan: tunai/aset cair tidak cukup untuk menunaikan obligasi (masalah tunai) (2)
Aset rosot nilai menjana sedikit tunai dan sukar dijual, memburukkan kecairan (2)
Bayaran melebihi untung menyusutkan tunai dan mendedahkan dana kepada risiko pengeluaran, menambah tekanan menyembunyikan kerugian (2)

q.en: Write ONE audit finding on the non-recognition of impairment of investments in subsidiaries and associates, using the four elements: criteria, condition, cause and effect.
q.ms: Tulis SATU penemuan audit tentang tidak mengiktiraf rosot nilai pelaburan dalam subsidiari dan syarikat bersekutu, menggunakan empat unsur: kriteria, keadaan, punca dan kesan.

en: Criteria: MFRS 136 para 9 (assess indications) and para 59–60 (write down; loss in profit or loss) (2)
Condition: RM227.81 million not recognised on three subsidiaries and three associates, including RM164.58 million on TH Heavy Engineering (2)
Cause: RAV approach instead of carrying amounts after impairment testing; policy changes; weak oversight (2)
Effect: profit and net assets overstated; 2017 profit RM3.4 billion should have been a RM1.4 billion loss; hibah paid on profit not earned (2)
ms: Kriteria: MFRS 136 para 9 (nilai petunjuk) dan para 59–60 (tulis turun; kerugian dalam untung atau rugi) (2)
Keadaan: RM227.81 juta tidak diiktiraf atas tiga subsidiari dan tiga syarikat bersekutu, termasuk RM164.58 juta atas TH Heavy Engineering (2)
Punca: pendekatan RAV bukannya amaun dibawa selepas ujian rosot nilai; perubahan dasar; pengawasan lemah (2)
Kesan: untung dan aset bersih terlebih nyata; untung 2017 RM3.4 bilion sepatutnya rugi RM1.4 bilion; hibah dibayar atas untung yang belum diperoleh (2)
